scholarships.title: NTU President Award
scholarships.official_source: Nanyang Technological University, Office of Admissions

existing.description: More on tuition fees for part-time and full-time programmes.
eligibility: Successful awardees should read a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU
Possess outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, a diploma awarded by a polytechnic in Singapore, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Applicants must be entering a full-time undergraduate degree programme at NTU with outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, Singapore polytechnic diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent results, excellent co-curricular records and strong leadership qualities and potential.
benefits: Fully subsidised NTU hostel place guaranteed for four years
Mentoring by NTU senior management and notable alumni
Developmental opportunities such as URECA, talent development opportunities and priority exchange
Enrolment into NTU Honours College, NTU's flagship undergraduate college
For applicants who require further financial aid and meet further terms: an overseas travel allowance of $10,000 (one-off), tuition fee coverage via bursaries and an annual study allowance of $10,000
coverage: Fully subsidised 4-year guarantee for NTU hostel
Mentoring opportunities with NTU senior management and notable alumni
Developmental opportunities including URECA, talent development programmes and priority exchange
requirements: Submit the NTU admission application before the scholarship application
Maintain a minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average of 3.5 over 5.0, reviewed every semester
Do not concurrently hold any other scholarship, university loan or award without the University's approval
Take on the role of student ambassador or a similar university representative role when called upon
Pay back the award if it is terminated prematurely
documents: Completed NTU scholarship application form, reached through the 'Apply for Scholarship' link at the end of the online admission application using the assigned application number
Personal Essay of not more than 250 words on the compulsory topic in the scholarship application form
Recent passport-size digital photograph uploaded after the form is submitted
Copy of family identification documents and income documents, uploaded together with the Document Checklist as a single file
Online referee's appraisal completed by a school teacher who is not a family member or relative, submitted within 7 days of the scholarship application
application_method: Apply for admission to NTU first and obtain the assigned application number
Complete the online scholarship application form, including the compulsory 250-word Personal Essay
Upload a recent passport-size photo and a single file containing family identification and income documents with the Document Checklist
Forward the generated referee URL to a school teacher with the NTU application number and date of birth, so the online appraisal is filed within 7 days
Attend the scholarship selection interview if shortlisted, between March and May
existing.selection_notes: Selection interviews take place between March and May and only shortlisted applicants are informed by email by mid-May, so applicants should be ready to attend at short notice. Applicants with Year 12 equivalent results are interviewed within 2 months of the NTU programme offer and are notified by email within a month of that offer. Only one referee appraisal may be submitted per application. The additional financial-aid package for applicants who require further support is subject to meeting further terms and conditions.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional school leavers of any nationality with outstanding A Level, polytechnic, IB, NUS High School or equivalent results, an excellent co-curricular record and strong leadership, who want a fully subsidised NTU hostel place and intensive leadership development alongside NTU Honours College.
existing.notes: The published standard benefits do not include full tuition fee coverage; tuition fee coverage via bursaries is listed only as possible additional support for applicants who require further financial aid and meet further terms and conditions. The award carries no NTU bond, but the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme bond applies where the student is not a Singapore Citizen. The award may be withdrawn if the University judges progress or behaviour unsatisfactory, and repayment is imposed on premature termination.
existing.duration: Up to the normal programme duration at NTU, with academic performance reviewed every semester
existing.application_period: Tied to the NTU undergraduate admission application period, so the closing date depends on the applicant's qualification and admission route.
existing.deadline_display: The same application period for admissions applies. The scholarship application period is the same as the admission application period. Applications submitted after the closing date will not be considered.

existing.description: The SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award is Singapore Management University's premier flagship undergraduate scholarship, open to Singapore Citizens entering a full-time degree programme and awarded on academic excellence, leadership and co-curricular or community record. The published benefits, applying from Academic Year 2028-29, are a waiver of subsidised tuition fees for regular terms for up to 4 years, a S$5,000 annual living allowance, a S$14,000 GLOW grant for overseas exposure and community service, a S$1,800 computer allowance, a S$9,000 Enhanced Flexibility Grant and up to S$40,000 for an optional concurrent or sequential SMU Master's programme. The scholarship is bond-free and is applied for through the Scholarship section of the SMU admission application.
eligibility: Possess outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, local Polytechnic Diploma, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent qualifications
Demonstrate strong leadership capabilities and potential
Possess an excellent record in co-curricular and/or community activities
Be applying for admission to a full-time undergraduate degree programme at SMU
existing.eligibility_summary: Singapore Citizens applying for admission to a full-time SMU undergraduate degree programme, with outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' level, local Polytechnic Diploma, International Baccalaureate Diploma, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent qualifications, strong leadership capabilities and potential, and an excellent record in co-curricular and/or community activities.
benefits: Subsidised tuition fee waiver for regular terms for up to 4 years
S$14,000 GLOW grant for overseas exposure and community service
S$1,800 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment
Funding for a concurrent or sequential SMU Master's programme of up to S$40,000
Participation in development opportunities offered by the Student Success Centre
coverage: Waiver of annual subsidised tuition fees for regular terms, semesters 1 and 2, for up to 4 years, starting from Academic Year 2028-29

S$14,000 Global Learning Opportunities Worldwide (GLOW) grant for overseas exchange or summer programmes, overseas community service projects, overseas school study missions, overseas case competitions and conference presentations
S$1,800 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment
S$9,000 Enhanced Flexibility Grant usable for on-campus accommodation at Prinsep Street Residences, an overseas exchange, or approved professional certifications
Option to pursue a concurrent or sequential SMU Master's programme of up to S$40,000
requirements: Indicate interest in the Scholarship section of the online admission application form, as there is no separate scholarship application form
Enrol in a full-time undergraduate degree programme at SMU
All scholars are enrolled in at least one SMU-X module as part of the scholars' core curriculum
Scholars may chart their own destinations for GLOW exchanges and community service projects
documents: Scholarship personal essay completed and submitted online within the SMU admission application
Letters of recommendation from a tutor or principal, optional but strongly encouraged, submitted online by the referee
application_method: Submit the SMU undergraduate admission application form
Indicate interest in the award in the Scholarship section of that form
Complete the scholarship personal essay online as part of the admission application
Nominate a referee if seeking a letter of recommendation, allowing enough time for the referee to submit it online
Attend a panel interview at SMU if shortlisted
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are shortlisted based on their academic qualifications and the strength of their non-academic records, and shortlisted applicants are invited to SMU for a panel interview. Only shortlisted applicants are invited for scholarship or admissions interviews, and notifications are sent in batches between the dates published on SMU's Important Dates page.
existing.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with outstanding A Level, polytechnic, IB or NUS High School results, strong leadership and an excellent co-curricular or community record, seeking a bond-free tuition waiver with funded overseas exposure at SMU.
existing.notes: The published tuition waiver covers regular terms only, that is semesters 1 and 2, so special-term tuition is not covered. The published benefits carry the note "starting from Academic Year 2028-29", which is the cohort for which these figures apply. All SMU scholars read at least one SMU-X module as part of the scholars' core curriculum.
existing.duration: Up to 4 years of subsidised tuition fee waiver, with an option to add an SMU Master's programme
existing.application_period: Tied to the SMU undergraduate admission cycle, published annually on SMU's Important Dates page. The published cycle for Academic Year 2026-27 ran 17 November 2025 to 19 March 2026; dates for the next intake were not published as at this verification.
existing.deadline_display: There is no separate scholarship application. Scholarship interest is indicated in the Scholarship section of the SMU undergraduate online admission application, which for Academic Year 2026-27 opened on 17 November 2025 at 12.00pm and closed on 19 March 2026 at 11.59pm, Singapore Standard Time.
